meta.name: what-breaks
meta.description: Assess the impact of a proposed change on dependencies and shared infrastructure. Use before touching unfamiliar or consequential systems.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 动手改动前先摸清会牵动哪些依赖和公共设施
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正要改一处不熟悉或影响面大的系统,想先知道会牵连到什么。
copy.tagline_en: Map which dependencies and shared infrastructure a change will touch before you make it
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're about to change an unfamiliar or high-impact system and want to know what it will affect.

howto.what: 在改动不熟悉或重要的系统前，帮你评估这次改动会影响到哪些依赖和共享基础设施。它会先读任务上下文契约与方法文档，再基于给定信息给出影响判断。
howto.when: 当你准备改动不熟悉或有重大影响的系统，提出评估改动影响时触发；若由 @fde 调用，则沿用其当前的脱敏数据包与范围。

say.text: 我要改这个共享库的接口，先帮我评估会影响哪些依赖。
say.note: 它会先读上下文契约与方法再评估。

say.text: 这个不熟的模块我想动一下，改动前先看看会波及什么。
say.note: 按依赖与共享基础设施两个方向排查。

say.text: 帮我判断这次部署改动的验证和验收影响面。
say.note: 会区分实现、验证、部署与验收。

howto.what_en: Before touching unfamiliar or consequential systems, it assesses how a proposed change affects dependencies and shared infrastructure. It first reads the task context contract and method, then reports impact from the given context.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are about to change an unfamiliar or consequential system, or ask for a change-impact assessment. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope.

say_en.text: I'm changing this shared library's interface; assess which dependencies it hits.
say_en.note: It reads the context contract and method first.

say_en.text: I want to touch this unfamiliar module; check what it affects first.
say_en.note: Looks at dependencies and shared infrastructure.

say_en.text: Judge the verification and acceptance impact of this deploy change.
say_en.note: It separates implementation, verification, deployment, acceptance.
